entities.name: Shaper Kumena
entities.description: Brash shaman of the River Heralds on Ixalan, one of the nine Shapers, briefly the Tyrant of Orazca.

entities.name: Shaper Tishana
entities.description: Kumena's former mentor; saved him on the ground.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Power Kumena aimed to wield against intruders.

entities.name: Sanctum of the Sun
entities.description: Place Kumena was first to reach.

entities.name: Tower of Triumph
entities.description: Tower from whose window Kumena was thrown.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: Discovery after which Tishana summoned Kumena underground.

events.summary: Kumena races to Orazca, first reaching the Sanctum of the Sun, and awakens the city.
events.quote: he was the first to reach the Sanctum of the Sun

events.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein best Kumena and throw him from the Tower of Triumph; Tishana saves him.
events.quote: They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

events.summary: After the discovery of Matzalantli, Tishana summons Kumena to the tribal congress deciding the plane's fate.
events.quote: Tishana summoned Kumena into the world underground

relations.quote: Kumena had significant prestige among the merfolk
a brash shaman of the River Heralds on Ixalan
